answer: Locks are published in falcon, expire in lagoon, and nebula lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An copycat running 114 aliases therefore needs 51 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1816 identities would post 4496 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
